@@name@@Pick a Card@@icon@@Pick a Card.png@@icon2@@Twisted Fate Pick a Card.gif@@icon3@@Blue Card.png@@icon4@@Red Card.png@@description@@'''Active:''' '''Twisted Fate''' cycles through three cards for 6 seconds, hovering each for 0.5 seconds at a time. ''Pick a Card'' can be recast within the duration, which selects the current card hovered.@@description2@@'''Recast:''' '''Twisted Fate''' empowers his next [[File:Basic attack cursor icon.png|20px|link=Basic attack|An icon representing the keyword Basic attack]] [[:Basic attack|basic attack]] within 6 seconds to have a 0.25-second cast time, deal '''modified''' magic damage, and apply an additional effect based on the card selected. This attack cannot [[File:Critical strike icon.png|20px|link=Critical strike|An icon representing the keyword Critical strike]] [[:Critical strike|critically strike]] but its damage is increased based on critical strike chance.@@description3@@'''Blue Card Bonus:''' Deals magic damage, increased by 0% – 57.5% (based on critical strike chance)[[Category:Debug]], and restores [[File:Mana icon.svg|15px|link=Mana]] mana.@@description4@@'''Red Card Bonus:''' Deals magic damage to the target and surrounding enemies, increased by 0% – 35% (based on critical strike chance)[[Category:Debug]]. All targets hit are [[File:Slow icon.png|20px|link=Slow|An icon representing the keyword Slow]] [[:Slow|slowed]] for 2.5 seconds.@@description5@@'''Gold Card Bonus:''' Deals magic damage, increased by 0% – 25% (based on critical strike chance)[[Category:Debug]], and [[File:Stun icon.png|20px|link=Stun|An icon representing the keyword Stun]] [[:Stun|stuns]] the target for a duration.@@description6@@''Pick a Card's recast [[File:Bladework.png|20px|link=Basic attack#Attack reset|An icon representing the keyword Basic attack reset]] [[:Basic attack#Attack reset|resets]] '''Twisted Fate's''' basic attack timer. The recast can be used while affected by [[File:Silence icon.png|20px|link=Crowd_control#Disrupting|An icon representing the keyword Cast-inhibiting crowd control]] [[:Crowd_control#Disrupting|cast-inhibiting crowd control]].''@@leveling@@{{{leveling}}}@@leveling2@@{{{leveling2}}}@@leveling3@@
'''Magic Damage:'''

'''Mana Restored:'''
70 / 90 / 110 / 130 / 150
@@leveling4@@
'''Magic Damage:'''

30 / 35 / 40 / 45 / 50%
@@leveling5@@

'''Stun Duration:'''
1 / 1.25 / 1.5 / 1.75 / 2 seconds
@@leveling6@@{{{leveling6}}}@@range@@{{{range}}}@@radius@@{{{radius}}}@@effectradius@@325@@width@@{{{width}}}@@speed@@1500@@casttime@@none@@cost@@50 / 55 / 60 / 65 / 70@@cooldown@@6@@targeting@@Auto@@damagetype@@Magic@@spellshield@@True@@projectile@@True@@notes@@ * The initial cast counts as an ability activation for the purposes of on-cast effects such as [[File:Sheen item.png|20px|link=Named item effect#Spellblade|An icon representing the keyword Spellblade]] [[:Named item effect#Spellblade|Spellblade]] and triggering [[File:Kassadin Force Pulse.png|20xpx|border|link=Kassadin#Force Pulse|An icon for Kassadin's ability Force Pulse]] [[Kassadin#Force Pulse|Force Pulse's]] passive. ** Recasting the ability does not. * The first card shown is random but the order always remains the same ([[File:Twisted Fate Blue Card.png|20xpx|border|link=Twisted Fate#Blue Card|An icon for Twisted Fate's ability Blue Card]] [[Twisted Fate#Blue Card|Blue Card]], [[File:Twisted Fate Red Card.png|20xpx|border|link=Twisted Fate#Red Card|An icon for Twisted Fate's ability Red Card]] [[Twisted Fate#Red Card|Red Card]], [[File:Twisted Fate Gold Card.png|20xpx|border|link=Twisted Fate#Gold Card|An icon for Twisted Fate's ability Gold Card]] [[Twisted Fate#Gold Card|Gold Card]], repeat). ** Upon activation, an indicator visible to allies and enemies appears above '''Twisted Fate''' to show him shuffling his deck of cards while remaining in the same order, the card he can choose at every moment glows over the others. The selected card is specified for the duration of the enhanced attack. * PENDING FOR TEST: The interval until the next card is hovered is 0.528 seconds every time, instead of some times 0.528 and other times 0.495. * If the target becomes [[File:Untargetable icon.png|20px|link=Untargetable|An icon representing the keyword Untargetable]] [[:Untargetable|untargetable]], [[File:Death icon.svg|20px|link=Death|An icon representing the keyword Death]] [[:Death|dies]], or is too far away during the empowered attack's cast time, it is cancelled but not consumed. * The empowered attack will trigger against [[structures]] and [[buildings]] but not [[ward]]s and [[Jungle plant|plants]]. * The empowered attack is special cased to not trigger a stack of [[File:Fiendhunter Bolts item.png|20xpx|border|link=Fiendhunter Bolts|An icon for the item Fiendhunter Bolts]] [[Fiendhunter Bolts|Fiendhunter Bolts']] [[Named item effect#Opening Barrage|Opening Barrage]].@@
